note: generated; do not edit. Targets are the catalog's starting values; no panel has a query yet.

live.title: adoption_rate
live.definition: Active users divided by eligible users.

live.title: after_the_fact_review_error_rate
live.definition: Error rate found in the ~5% sample of auto-approved cases re-reviewed after the fact — the only measurement of the automatic path's true error rate.
live.target: < 0.02 (triggers automatic demotion to shadow mode if exceeded, BUILD-SPEC.md §14.7)

live.title: audit_log_completeness
live.definition: Share of in-scope actions (every write, every approval, every model decision feeding an approval) that are reconstructable from the audit log.

live.title: automation_rate
live.definition: Share of jobs handled without human intervention, shown beside the clinic's current autonomy mode — not a target to maximize on its own.
live.target: matches the business case assumption for the current mode

live.title: backfill_fill_rate
live.definition: Share of cancelled slots successfully refilled from the waitlist before the appointment time.

live.title: barrier_resolution_rate
live.definition: Share of identified no-show barriers (BUILD-SPEC.md §22.4) resolved -- either rebooked or the front-desk follow-up closed -- versus left open.

live.title: cache_hit_rate
live.definition: Hit rate for each caching mechanism separately (prompt-prefix, exact-match, semantic, request-scoped) — never blended into one number.

live.title: canary_catch_rate
live.definition: Share of planted canary tasks (1-2% of the review queue, synthetic referrals with a deliberate error) that were correctly caught (not approved) by reviewers.

live.title: care_gap_median_age
live.definition: Median age of open Care Gaps panel items, by source. A rising trend signals the review process is falling behind generation of new gaps, independent of the raw count.

live.title: care_gap_open_count
live.definition: Count of open items on the Care Gaps panel (BUILD-SPEC.md §24.1), by source: overdue-recurrence, after-the-fact-review, unresolved-barrier.

live.title: cost_per_completed_task
live.definition: Total token plus tool-call cost for tasks that actually succeeded — the failure multiplier (see below) folds a cheap-but-wrong path back into this number.
live.target: within cost-canvas tolerance (BUILD-SPEC.md §15.1), +/-20% of dry-run estimate

live.title: cost_per_query
live.definition: Total retrieval plus generation cost for one model-touching request.

live.title: cost_per_successful_workflow
live.definition: Total cost divided by count of workflows verified successful, per workflow type.

live.title: cost_tail_top_5_percent
live.definition: The costliest 5% of jobs by spend, reviewed weekly.

live.title: dead_letter_count
live.definition: Count of jobs in the dead-letter table awaiting manual intervention.

live.title: error_rate
live.definition: Share of API requests returning a 5xx response.

live.title: escalation_rate_and_accuracy
live.definition: How often the system escalates to a human, split by reason code 'unnecessary escalation' (over-escalation) and 'missed by system' (under-escalation, surfaced via the 5% after-the-fact review and canaries).
live.target: matches the calibrated autonomy dial for the clinic's current mode

live.title: failure_multiplier
live.definition: Effective cost per success divided by nominal cost per call — the number that reveals a 'cheap' model is actually expensive once its error rate is priced in.

live.title: fallback_and_abstention_spike
live.definition: Sudden rise in decision-engine fallback usage or retrieval abstention rate versus the rolling baseline — an early signal of a provider issue.

live.title: first_pass_success_rate
live.definition: Share of workflows that succeeded without any retry, escalation to a larger model, or human correction.

live.title: followups_closed_vs_lost
live.definition: Share of care-plan conditional follow-ups that reached a decided close-out versus went overdue/lost.

live.title: grounding_rate
live.definition: Share of decision-relevant extracted facts that pass their tiered grounding check (BUILD-SPEC.md §11.2), computed live since no free-text answers reach patients.

live.title: index_freshness_lag
live.definition: Time delta between a card's publish event and its reflected version in the vector index (BUILD-SPEC.md §10.8).

live.title: intake_completion_rate
live.definition: Share of visits with a matched card's declared intake questions fully answered before the visit, versus left as an incomplete-intake flag for front desk.

live.title: latency_external_wait
live.definition: Elapsed time a completed job spent waiting on a patient reply or an external result (e.g. an echo report).

live.title: latency_human_wait
live.definition: Elapsed time a completed job spent waiting on a human review decision.

live.title: latency_p95_machine
live.definition: p95 wall-clock time for the machine-controlled portion of a completed job — excludes human wait and external wait (patient reply, pending result), reported separately.

live.title: loop_failure_rate
live.definition: Share of jobs that hit a step ceiling, retry ceiling, or a detectable unproductive loop (BUILD-SPEC.md §7.3 ceilings).

live.title: model_dependency_health
live.definition: Deprecation notices or silent behavior changes detected by the scheduled model-verification job (BUILD-SPEC.md §5.3).
live.target: no unplanned breaking change reaches production

live.title: no_show_rate
live.definition: Share of booked appointments where the patient did not attend.

live.title: queue_depth_and_oldest_age
live.definition: Current queue depth and the age of the oldest unclaimed job.

live.title: readiness_escalation_rate
live.definition: Share of procedure-readiness checklists with at least one not-done or unclear answer, requiring nurse escalation (BUILD-SPEC.md §22.3). Not a target to minimize by relaxing the escalation rule -- every one of these is a correct, required escalation.

live.title: red_flag_task_overdue
live.definition: Any open red-flag escalation task past its due time (due time is immediate for emergency-template cases).

live.title: referral_to_appointment_time
live.definition: Elapsed time from referral receipt to a booked appointment.

live.title: review_queue_age
live.definition: Age distribution of open review tasks, by required role.

live.title: rollback_frequency
live.definition: Count of production rollbacks per month — a rising trend signals an unstable release process.

live.title: safety_net_fail_closed_rate
live.definition: Count of times the decision-engine safety net had no available engine and correctly escalated to a nurse rather than proceeding unscreened.

live.title: step_efficiency
live.definition: Steps/tool-calls actually taken per completed job versus the minimum necessary — catches a 'busy but wasteful' agent.

live.title: task_completion_rate
live.definition: Share of jobs verified against their actual end state as successful — not merely 'the agent stopped'.

live.title: tool_status_mix
live.definition: Distribution of tool-call outcomes (ok / empty / degraded / unavailable) per tool, per day.

live.title: uptime
live.definition: Availability of the deterministic path (API + database) on paid hosting.

live.title: urgent_cases_seen_within_target
live.definition: Share of urgent-priority referrals seen within the clinic's target window.

live.title: voice_safety_escalation_rate
live.definition: Count of mid-session red-flag detections during an in-app Gemini Live voice session (BUILD-SPEC.md §11.6, §23.3) and whether each correctly triggered the spoken safety response and nurse acknowledgment. Mirrors red_flag_task_overdue's urgency: a missed voice escalation leaves no text trail to catch it later.
live.target: 100% of detected red flags trigger the safety response

live.title: voice_scope_adherence_rate
live.definition: Share of in-app voice sessions (BUILD-SPEC.md §23.2) where the patient's request stayed within the session's scoped task (a booking reply, a specific intake or readiness question) and any out-of-scope attempt (a clinical question, an open-ended request) was correctly declined and routed to text-based human review rather than the model improvising an answer outside its instructed scope.

live.title: wrong_merge_rate
live.definition: Any patient-record merge later reversed via the unmerge procedure, against the labeled identity-matching pair set.

test.title: answer_relevancy
test.definition: For model-drafted text only (records-request letters, plan summaries) — judge score of whether the draft addresses what was asked.

test.title: card_recall_at_3
test.definition: Of the gold-set referrals with an expected card, the fraction where that card appeared in the top 3 retrieved candidates.

test.title: context_recall
test.definition: Of the facts needed to answer a labeled retrieval query, the fraction the retriever actually returned.

test.title: correct_abstention_rate
test.definition: Of the deliberately out-of-scope gold-set referrals, the fraction where the system correctly returned no card rather than a false match.

test.title: engine_agreement
test.definition: Agreement rate between Laya, Jev, and the LLM fallback on the same golden decision-engine inputs (the three-engine contract test, BUILD-SPEC.md §5.2/§14.3).

test.title: evaluation_spend
test.definition: Total spend attributable to evaluation runs (nightly + pre-release), tracked separately from production spend.

test.title: false_routing_rate
test.definition: Of the out-of-scope gold-set referrals, the fraction incorrectly routed to some card instead of abstaining.
test.target: as low as possible; tracked alongside correct_abstention_rate

test.title: golden_set_vs_variance_band
test.definition: Current golden-set score against the variance band (baseline mean minus 2 standard deviations over 3 unchanged runs) for each gated metric.

test.title: guardrail_trigger_accuracy
test.definition: False-positive and false-negative rate of every guardrail (input isolation classifier, tiered grounding checks, scope-enforcement classifier) against the adversarial gold set.
test.target: 100% of known attack patterns blocked or safely handled (red-team pass rate)

test.title: priority_accuracy
test.definition: Of the gold-set referrals, the fraction where the computed priority matched the clinician-labeled priority.

test.title: red_flag_recall
test.definition: Of the gold-set cases with a genuine red flag, the fraction the deterministic rules correctly fired on, before any model call.

test.title: tool_call_accuracy
test.definition: Share of tool calls that selected the correct tool with valid, correct arguments, against the labeled trajectory set.

test.title: urgent_case_recall
test.definition: Of the gold-set cases labeled urgent, the fraction the system correctly prioritized as urgent.
